marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 原生家庭木馬快篩 : 三步驟解鎖並拋棄繼承家族負向印記 | Yuan sheng jia ting mu ma kuai shai : san bu zou jie suo bing pao qi ji cheng jia zu fu xiang yin ji

The wounds caused by family members—the negative imprints left by our family of origin—heal too slowly, are too hard to forget, and forgiveness often feels out of reach. Once these scars are etched into our body and mind, they leave us burdened with mistrust, self-doubt, guilt, shame, fear, anger, hatred, neediness, and helplessness—patterns that continue to generate problems and lead us to repeat the same painful cycles. The only way out is through a three-step rapid scan to uncover the core "Trojan horse" imprints passed down through generations. By identifying and courageously discarding what no longer serves us, we can break free from the negative scripts of family destiny. This awakening allows us to transform our emotional scars into fuel for rebirth and personal growth. From there, we apply a higher-dimensional decoding method—the Ultimate Life Formula (RAM)—to escape the matrix of inherited life patterns. This process restores our original inner settings, reconnects us to a pure and untainted seed consciousness, and empowers us to live with true freedom, creating an expansive and limitless life of our own design
